rows.name: pilot-mule-plain
rows.prompt: Keep this painting exactly: the same mule, the same pose, legs, hooves, head, ears, tail, outline, colours and size, facing the same way. Remove only the load: take away the bundle of grass and every strap, rope and pack saddle that holds it, showing the mule's plain bare back, and give it a plain rope halter on its head. Same plain pale grey background. No people, no text.

rows.name: pilot-elder-stand
rows.prompt: Keep this person exactly: the same old man, the same face, hair, hat, clothes, colours, outline, painted style and size. Change only his pose: standing still, facing the viewer, his arms hanging relaxed at his sides, both feet on the ground. Same plain pale grey background. One person, no text.

mule.groundLine: 909 px in all four, as hers
mule.notes: the grass load, its straps and the pack saddle gone with no ghost; a plain rope halter; legs and hooves where hers were (IoU of the lower 35% of her silhouette 0.97-0.99)

facecheck.nearest: his own face in all four, below the 0.40 floor

elder.notes: one head and two hands each, the same coat, hat and trousers, but the bundle he carries survives as a white cloth knotted at his chest in all four (a leftover ghost); turned from profile to the front, his face is a new drawing rather than her line
